data.description: Open on weekdays from 8:00 am to 3:00 pm. Closed on weekends and federal holidays. Located in Pago Pago village, across from the Pago Way Service Station.

operatingHours.description:
Offering essential information, interactive exhibits, and a chance to learn about the park’s unique cultural and natural heritage, the visitor center provides an introduction to everything that makes this park special. The cooperating association, Hawai'i Pacific Parks Association, supports the park by offering related books and memorabilia for your special trip.

*NOTE: when cruise ships are in port visitors center will open regardless if it's a weekend or holiday.
